forge_intro: Cleared opens pull requests and reads their checks on the forge your code lives on, with an access token. Pick the forge, then paste the token: Cleared checks it there at once and keeps it in a file on this machine only.
forge_github_intro: Create a fine-grained token for the repositories Cleared works on, with the permissions below, and paste it here.
forge_create: Create a fine-grained token on GitHub
forge_use_contents: clones, pushes a session's branch, merges after your approval
forge_use_pull_requests: opens, edits, comments on and closes pull requests
forge_use_commit_statuses: reads the checks of a pull request
forge_use_workflows: only if a ticket may change .github/workflows/
forge_use_issues: only for the GitHub Issues mirror
forge_classic: GitHub names the permissions in English, as here. A classic token with the repo scope works too.
forge_ok_one: GitHub accepted the token. It reaches 1 repository: {names}.
forge_ok_many: GitHub accepted the token. It reaches {count} repositories, among them {names}.
forge_ok_more: GitHub accepted the token. It reaches more than {count} repositories, among them {names}.
forge_set: A token is saved, since {date}. It is never shown again.
forge_set_undated: A token is saved. It is never shown again.
forge_set_environment: The token comes from the GH_TOKEN variable of Cleared's environment. Change it there.
forge_error_invalid: Paste the token alone, on one line.
forge_error_refused: GitHub refused this token. It may be mistyped, expired or revoked.
forge_error_forbidden: GitHub answered 403: the token lacks a permission, or the organisation has not approved it yet.
forge_error_unreachable: GitHub did not answer. Check this machine's network, then try again.
forge_error_empty: The token reaches no repository yet, so give it access to the repositories Cleared works on.
forge_error_environment: The token comes from Cleared's environment: change GH_TOKEN there.
forge_error_other: The token could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
gitlab_intro: Create a personal access token on your GitLab, for an account that is a member of the projects Cleared works on. GitLab calls a pull request a merge request.
gitlab_scope_use: opens, comments on, closes and merges merge requests, reads their pipelines, and clones and pushes over https
gitlab_role_use: on each project; Maintainer to merge into a protected branch
gitlab_address_hint: https://gitlab.com, or the https address of your own GitLab.
gitlab_create: Create a personal access token on this GitLab
gitlab_ok_one: GitLab accepted the token. It reaches 1 project: {names}.
gitlab_ok_many: GitLab accepted the token. It reaches {count} projects, among them {names}.
gitlab_ok_more: GitLab accepted the token. It reaches more than {count} projects, among them {names}.
gitlab_set: A GitLab token is saved for {host}, since {date}. It is never shown again.
gitlab_set_undated: A GitLab token is saved for {host}. It is never shown again.
gitlab_set_environment: The GitLab token comes from the file that CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE names in Cleared's environment. Change it there.
gitlab_error_invalid: Paste the token alone, on one line.
gitlab_error_address: Give your GitLab's https address, such as https://gitlab.com.
gitlab_error_refused: GitLab refused this token. It may be mistyped, expired or revoked.
gitlab_error_forbidden: GitLab answered 403: the account may be blocked, or an administrator limits its access.
gitlab_error_scope: The token lacks the api scope, which opening and merging a merge request need. Make one with the api scope.
gitlab_error_unreachable: GitLab did not answer. Check the address and this machine's network, then try again.
gitlab_error_empty: The token reaches no project yet, so make its account a member of the projects Cleared works on.
gitlab_error_environment: The token comes from Cleared's environment: change the file CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE names there.
gitlab_error_other: The token could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
